name: platform_process_adapters

test_list.description: Resolve a real executable to an absolute canonical path and classify batch scripts.
Reject secret-like and case-insensitive duplicate child environment keys.
Observe a real filesystem create and suppress ignored directory changes.
Start a native Windows PTY child and receive its output over the bounded byte channel.
Opt-in ConPTY throughput workload counts a 100 MiB stream without retaining its bytes.
Run a native executable with static argv and collect bounded output without shell interpretation.
Cap retained stdout and stderr while draining excess output to prevent child deadlock.
Enforce a deadline and terminate the complete owned process tree.

output_description: A real process, terminal, executable-resolution, or filesystem-watch adapter result.
